value.body: A two-year Master's that studies education as an academic field — learning theory, philosophy and sociology of education, educational policy, curriculum, and research methods. Unlike the M.Ed, it does not require a B.Ed and is not a teaching licence.

items.label: Postgraduate students in Education
items.source: AISHE 2023-24, Table 13, actual responses (Ministry of Education)

value.title: How you get in
value.body: A bachelor's degree; many universities accept any subject, and some prefer Education studied at B.A. level. Central universities admit through CUET-PG; others use their own tests or graduation marks.

value.title: At a glance
items: It leads to research, education policy and NGO work, curriculum roles, and UGC-NET in Education.
School teaching still needs a B.Ed.
A Ph.D. after it opens college teaching of Education.

value.title: Postgraduate students in Education
value.note: Includes M.Ed as well as M.A. Education; AISHE does not separate them in this table. AISHE counts responding institutions only; coverage varies by year, so part of any change may reflect reporting rather than real enrolment.
value.source: AISHE 2021-22, 2022-23 and 2023-24, Table 13 (PG enrolment by discipline, Education total), actual responses (Ministry of Education)
